consequence.statement: After upgrading to 3.0.0, the dynamic cluster distribution behavior affected by issue #20965 is corrected (shard-related handling behaves differently than before); the evidence states no failure, rejection, or required migration.
consequence.remediation: Verify dynamic cluster distribution and shard behavior after upgrading; the evidence states no required operator action.

original.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 ships a bug fix (commit d183d9c614d05979f1327a554942a9e656f1c2ec, PR #21042) for the dynamic cluster distribution issue #20965 involving shard updating; the changelog line is truncated and names no specific setting, field, flag, or component.

decision.reason: [ev-216c1792aec9] describes the bug. With dynamic cluster distribution, when the argocd-app-controller-shard-cm exists and there is more than one replica, a restarted app controller pod can end up with shard -1, stop processing applications and leave them stuck refreshing. [ev-fc6423b07d19] describes the fix: the readiness health check now updates the controller's shard number when it has changed and then resyncs all applications. Nothing here says that anything fails, is rejected or needs an operator step after the upgrade. The controller just handles sharding differently, so behavior-change with low severity (review) is supported.
